title: Review verdict (gate profile)
description: Canonical artifact form of a review verdict. Message form equivalence: verdict: APPROVE <=> (status=pass AND blocking_findings==0); verdict: REQUEST_CHANGES <=> (status=fail OR blocking_findings>0). Normalization of message values: strip all whitespace, uppercase, PASS->APPROVE, FAIL->REQUEST_CHANGES. Gate profile is lenient: a missing blocking_findings reads as 0 and unknown extra fields are ignored. The strict, fail-closed `merge` profile (SHA-bound, evidence-required) is implementation-private and out of loopspec scope.
